records.finding: Definite plural adjective agreement supports the plural modifier plus plural noun. The exact proposed phrase is an application of the rule, not a quotation.
Appendix A supports definiteness and accusative on the adjectival modifier of this unpossessed object; the noun need not duplicate them.

The older LibreOffice help contains an entire singular original-size object plus return predicate, not only an isolated noun phrase. This supports the size-restoration relation, not automatic acceptance of the plural command.

LibreOffice Writer corroborates the original-size sense in another size-reset context. This live help is not an immutable revision and does not independently establish translator provenance.
AOSP uses the same imperative verb in Restore. The complete AOSP label has an additional original-state complement; archived-app restoration semantics are not transferred.
